scope: First frozen held-out evaluation; no training or checkpoint selection
bbox_dtype: float32, then tolist exactly as frozen online adapter
encoding: PNG for every view including clean; compression3
NMS: p57.complete_validation.complete_nms; unlimited wall clock; multi_label=True from pinned DetectionValidator
PR: macro class P/R at common smoothed mean-class best-F1 index; not fixed0.25

failure_rule.space: stored metric/input coordinates and stored IoU matrix; original coordinates for drawing
failure_rule.matching: pinned greedy class-aware IoU matching after confidence filtering; wrong-class may be FP and FN
failure_rule.FP_FN_selection: up to3 unique source IDs per type; sort by descending failure count then source_id, condition order, model order
failure_rule.paired_cases: worst C-minus-A error count; best C-minus-A error count; hardest equal-error neutral; hardest total errors. Strict sign needed for better/worse; absent categories declared
failure_rule.render: paired stored A/C predictions only; no separate prediction calls

evaluation_order: condition-major then A,C; separate fresh process and output dir per evaluation
preprocessing: Preserve frozen ScheduledYOLODataset resize/LetterBox/Format: nominal imgsz416, rectTrue, stride32, default pad0.5; actual input shapes recorded (square sources typically448). No post-test preprocessing changes.
